check("max_depth([3, 9, 20, None, None, 15, 7])", lambda: max_depth(make_tree([3, 9, 20, None, None, 15, 7])), 3)
check("max_depth(empty tree)", lambda: max_depth(None), 0)
check("max_depth(single node) is 1", lambda: max_depth(make_tree([1])), 1)
check("max_depth(right-only chain)", lambda: max_depth(make_tree([1, None, 2, None, 3])), 3)
check("max_depth(left-only chain)", lambda: max_depth(make_tree([1, 2, None, 3, None, 4])), 4)
check("max_depth(deepest leaf on the left, under a short right side)", lambda: max_depth(make_tree([1, 2, 3, 4, None, None, None, 5])), 4)
check("max_depth(zero and negative values still count)", lambda: max_depth(make_tree([0, -1, -2])), 2)

check(
    "invert_tree([4, 2, 7, 1, 3, 6, 9])",
    lambda: level_order(invert_tree(make_tree([4, 2, 7, 1, 3, 6, 9]))),
    [4, 7, 2, 9, 6, 3, 1],
)
check("invert_tree([2, 1, 3])", lambda: level_order(invert_tree(make_tree([2, 1, 3]))), [2, 3, 1])
check("invert_tree(empty tree) is None", lambda: invert_tree(None), None)
check("invert_tree(single node)", lambda: level_order(invert_tree(make_tree([1]))), [1])
check("invert_tree(lopsided tree moves the chain to the right)", lambda: level_order(invert_tree(make_tree([1, 2, None, 3]))), [1, None, 2, None, 3])
check("invert_tree returns the same root object", lambda: (lambda root: invert_tree(root) is root)(make_tree([1, 2, 3])), True)
check("inverting twice gives the original tree", lambda: level_order(invert_tree(invert_tree(make_tree([4, 2, 7, 1, 3, 6, 9])))), [4, 2, 7, 1, 3, 6, 9])

check("is_valid_bst([2, 1, 3])", lambda: is_valid_bst(make_tree([2, 1, 3])), True)
check(
    "is_valid_bst catches a deep violation",
    lambda: is_valid_bst(make_tree([5, 1, 4, None, None, 3, 6])),
    False,
)
check("is_valid_bst(empty tree)", lambda: is_valid_bst(None), True)
check("is_valid_bst(single node)", lambda: is_valid_bst(make_tree([1])), True)
check("is_valid_bst(duplicate on the left is invalid)", lambda: is_valid_bst(make_tree([2, 2])), False)
check("is_valid_bst(duplicate on the right is invalid)", lambda: is_valid_bst(make_tree([2, None, 2])), False)
check("is_valid_bst(grandchild breaks the root's lower bound)", lambda: is_valid_bst(make_tree([5, 4, 6, None, None, 3, 7])), False)
check("is_valid_bst(full valid tree)", lambda: is_valid_bst(make_tree([8, 4, 12, 2, 6, 10, 14])), True)
check("is_valid_bst(zero and negative values)", lambda: is_valid_bst(make_tree([0, -5, 3, -9, -1])), True)

def find(root, value):
    while root is not None and root.val != value:
        root = root.left if value < root.val else root.right
    return root

bst = make_tree([6, 2, 8, 0, 4, 7, 9, None, None, 3, 5])
check("lowest_common_ancestor(2, 8)", lambda: lowest_common_ancestor(bst, find(bst, 2), find(bst, 8)).val, 6)
check("lowest_common_ancestor(2, 4)", lambda: lowest_common_ancestor(bst, find(bst, 2), find(bst, 4)).val, 2)
check("lowest_common_ancestor(8, 2), arguments swapped", lambda: lowest_common_ancestor(bst, find(bst, 8), find(bst, 2)).val, 6)
check("lowest_common_ancestor(3, 5), both deep on the left", lambda: lowest_common_ancestor(bst, find(bst, 3), find(bst, 5)).val, 4)
check("lowest_common_ancestor(0, 5)", lambda: lowest_common_ancestor(bst, find(bst, 0), find(bst, 5)).val, 2)
check("lowest_common_ancestor(7, 9), both on the right", lambda: lowest_common_ancestor(bst, find(bst, 7), find(bst, 9)).val, 8)
check("lowest_common_ancestor(6, 9), one node is the root", lambda: lowest_common_ancestor(bst, find(bst, 6), find(bst, 9)).val, 6)
check("lowest_common_ancestor(3, 3), p and q are the same node", lambda: lowest_common_ancestor(bst, find(bst, 3), find(bst, 3)).val, 3)
check("lowest_common_ancestor in a two-node tree", lambda: (lambda t: lowest_common_ancestor(t, find(t, 1), find(t, 2)).val)(make_tree([2, 1])), 2)

check(
    "level_order_groups([3, 9, 20, None, None, 15, 7])",
    lambda: level_order_groups(make_tree([3, 9, 20, None, None, 15, 7])),
    [[3], [9, 20], [15, 7]],
)
check("level_order_groups(empty tree)", lambda: level_order_groups(None), [])
check("level_order_groups(single node)", lambda: level_order_groups(make_tree([1])), [[1]])
check("level_order_groups(left-only chain)", lambda: level_order_groups(make_tree([1, 2, None, 3])), [[1], [2], [3]])
check("level_order_groups(right-only chain)", lambda: level_order_groups(make_tree([1, None, 2])), [[1], [2]])
check("level_order_groups(gaps in the middle of a level)", lambda: level_order_groups(make_tree([1, 2, 3, 4, None, None, 5])), [[1], [2, 3], [4, 5]])
check("level_order_groups(zero values are real nodes)", lambda: level_order_groups(make_tree([0, 0, 0])), [[0], [0, 0]])
